note: Adapted from the original English description by Emerson 1952; the species was originally a subspecies of C. acignathus (Snyder 1929) and was raised to species rank in 1952, the synonymy of the costaricensis subspecies being dealt with in the same work. Measurements translated verbatim from Tables 19 and 20 of the original, in millimetres. The worker is not described in the original.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate with a short postclypeus, indicating a close relationship with C. pugnax; the compound eyes are the largest known among alates of this genus (eye diameter 0.76 mm, head width 2.31 mm). Soldier with the lateral corners of the labrum sharper than in C. acignathus and C. pugnax, and the mandibular characters also differ (figs 14C, 15E of the original).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown; postclypeus slightly paler than the head; part of the pronotum concolorous with the head, the T-shaped central part paler than the postclypeus; tibiae slightly darker than the femora; tergites concolorous with the postclypeus; sternites concolorous with the postclypeus at the sides and yellow in the middle. Head with a few scattered setae; pronotum with many setae and a few scattered short hairs on the anterior margin; tergites setose; sternites with setae and hairs. Frontal gland large, not longer than the ocellus but wider than it, convex, covered with thin pale cuticle. Compound eyes large, about 1/11 of their diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli large, smaller than the antennal fossa, less than their own width from the compound eye, the upper margin slightly raised above the surface of the head. Antennae 15-segmented. Postclypeus distinctly less than half its width in length (0.37:0.88 mm), not strongly arched. Pronotum rounded at the sides, narrowing posteriorly, the posterior margin slightly concave. Measurements (mm; Table 19 of the original): head length to the tip of the labrum 2.30; head length to the lateral mandibular bases 1.70; head width 2.31; compound eye diameter 0.76; distance from the compound eye to the lower margin 0.07; ocellus length 0.37, width 0.24; distance from the ocellus to the compound eye 0.17; distance from the ocellus to the frontal gland 0.41; frontal gland length 0.32, width 0.27; pronotum length 1.00, width 1.94; hind tibia length 2.60.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, pronotum and abdomen pale yellow. Head with a few setae, more numerous in the anterior half, hairless below; postmentum with about 2 setae at the anterior end and very fine short hairs in the middle; pronotum with a few setae and short hairs on the anterior margin; tergites setose; sternites with short hairs and setae. Sides of the head fairly straight, slightly convergent anteriorly. Frontal tube slightly upturned, thicker at the base, its apex covering the base of the postclypeus from above. The narrowest part of the postmentum about 3/5 of the widest (0.42:0.70 mm). Antennae 15-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length. Lateral corners of the labrum obtuse. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly or indistinctly concave. Measurements (mm; Table 20 of the original, n=24—27, mean in parentheses): head length including the mandibles 4.15—4.90 (4.48); head length to the apex of the frontal tube 2.71—3.21 (2.99); head length to the lateral mandibular bases 2.93—3.54 (3.29); head width 2.64—3.07 (2.85); head thickness 1.94—2.26 (2.09); frontal tube length 0.52—0.60 (0.56); labrum width 0.74—0.84 (0.78); left mandible length 1.50—1.68 (1.61); right mandible length from the notch 0.75—0.83 (0.79); pronotum length 0.76—0.92 (0.82); pronotum width 1.25—1.47 (1.34); hind tibia length 2.18—2.50 (2.31).
